subject: general
question: There are six members in a family, named A, B, C, D, E and F. B is the wife of C. A is the son of E, E is the brother of C, D is the sister of A. B is the daughter-in-law of F. How is E related to D?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aecbe9ab6b7da7cca1ac2d356e84b8c992ce57c8b50affd73dfdd3dad30ceb2e.png] 

**Given:** There are six members in a family, named A, B, C, D, E and F.

1) B is the wife of C.

2) B is the daughter-in-law of F.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b1b3a4d158835276faa22d7651216f06c1ef1a1b705adb0405ee42377b574b25.png] 

3) A is the son of E, E is the brother of C, D is the sister of A.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2b5354580b3dd096f19ba9b8ccc20176823d8327eea930bedc26510b63ed20c9.png] 

Thus, E is the father of E.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1.
